objects.name: anisanas2
objects.description: Threat actor active on darkforums and underground marketplaces. Observed targeting Moroccan public infrastructure and multi-sector databases. Responsible for the RADEM Meknès breach and the coordinated multi-entity Moroccan data bundle sale in May 2026.

objects.name: PKA291
objects.description: Threat actor linked to coordinated Moroccan database extraction and sale operations. Collaborated with anisanas2 in the May 2026 massive Moroccan database bundle sale.

objects.name: RADEM Meknès
objects.description: Victim entity recorded by AFRINTEL in Morocco. Sector: Government / Public Utility. RADEM (Régie Autonome Intercommunale de Distribution d'Eau et d'Électricité de Meknès) is a public utility responsible for water and electricity distribution in Meknès and surrounding municipalities.

objects.name: AFRINTEL May 2026 incident 56: RADEM Meknès
objects.description: AFRINTEL recorded a publicly claimed data breach affecting RADEM Meknès (Morocco) on May 22, 2026. The threat actor anisanas2 claimed the extraction of approximately 1.1 million documents from this critical water and electricity public utility, including customer data (names, addresses, contract numbers) and operational data (service routes, agency records). An initial sample of 18,000 PDF documents was published with the full dataset announced for release within 24 hours. This represents one of the largest known breaches of a Moroccan public utility. Status: Claim - Data Sample Published. This incident is treated as a claim. AFRINTEL does not confirm the breach independently.

objects.name: Moroccan Multi-Entity Database Bundle
objects.description: Multi-entity dataset bundle recorded by AFRINTEL in Morocco. Covers Ministry of Justice (2M docs, 150K court records), NARSA (2M rows), OFPPT (400K rows), a logistics company (8M rows), and insurance sector initial access. Sold as a combined bundle by threat actors anisanas2 and PKA291.

objects.name: AFRINTEL May 2026 incident 57: Moroccan Multi-Entity Database Bundle Sale
objects.description: AFRINTEL recorded a publicly claimed large-scale Moroccan database bundle sale on May 31, 2026. Threat actors anisanas2 and PKA291 offered a combined dataset of over 12 million rows and documents covering: Ministry of Justice (2M docs, 150,000 court records, 3,000 USD), NARSA road safety agency (2M rows, 800 USD), OFPPT vocational training (400K rows), logistics company (8M rows), and insurance sector initial access. Global bundle price: 5,500 USD. The RADEM Meknès dataset is also included in this bundle (1.1M docs, 600 USD). This represents a coordinated multi-entity exfiltration campaign targeting Moroccan public and private sector data. Status: Claim - Data Sample Published. This incident is treated as a claim. AFRINTEL does not confirm the breach independently.
